_comment: Hand-authored league facts that the Sleeper API does not expose. Verified 2026-08-14: draft.start_time is null and there is no location field anywhere in the API, so the countdown and venue below MUST be maintained here. Everything else on the site comes from Sleeper.

draft._comment: From '2026 Draft Info.txt': 2026-08-15 9:00 PM, Mohegan Sun. The source said 'EST' but August 15 is inside daylight saving time, so Eastern is UTC-04:00 (EDT). Encoding -05:00 would make the countdown an hour late on draft night. startTime must always carry an explicit offset so the countdown is right in every timezone.
draft.typeNote: Linear, not snake — the round 1 order repeats identically in rounds 2 and 3.

venue.name: Mohegan Sun Casino
venue.mapsQuery: Mohegan Sun Casino, 1 Mohegan Sun Blvd, Uncasville, CT 06382

bylaws._comment: Export the Google Doc via File > Download > Markdown (.md) and save it to content/bylaws.md. The pipeline reads it, applies `replacements`, promotes bold ALL-CAPS labels to headings, and writes public/data/bylaws.json.
bylaws._replacementsComment: The doc is written in the commissioner's first person, but this site is not run by the commissioner. Applied in order as literal string replacements. The pipeline WARNS on any pattern that matches nothing, so a re-export that rewords these will surface rather than silently no-op.
replacements: To be collected by me before draft
To be collected by the commissioner before draft
I will collect venmo dues at the end of the season rather than people sending me for every single transaction.
The commissioner will collect venmo dues at the end of the season rather than people sending them for every single transaction.
Sleeper does not give me much control over picks
Sleeper does not give the commissioner much control over picks
the commissioner will auto-veto the trade

tankathon._comment: Projected next-year draft order. Per the bylaws the order is set by ascending regular-season Max Points For, so this is a live race to the bottom once the season starts. Rename freely — it is pure flavour.
tankathon.title: Tankathon
tankathon.subtitle: Dire for Jeremiah

news._comment: Fantasy/NFL news shown on the homepage. Fetched at build time so there is no CORS or client-side feed parsing. Verified reachable 2026-08-14; CBS and FantasyPros feeds are dead, do not add them back.
